rows.mother_status: REPUBLIC ACT (RA07784) enacted on 1994-08-04
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO STRENGTHEN TEACHER EDUCATION IN THE PHILIPPINES BY ESTABLISHING CENTERS OF EXCELLENCE, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Defines a "CENTER OF EXCELLENCE" as referring to a  public or private college, institute  or school, existing by itself or within  a school, and engaged in the formal and nonformal education of teachers. Prescribes the criteria for identifying schools as centers of excellence; designates the UP College of Education and the Philippine Normal College as national centers of excellence. * * *
rows.status: Substituted by HB10493

rows.mother_status: REPUBLIC ACT (RA07836) enacted on 1994-12-16
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO UPGRADE THE QUALITY OF THE TEACHING PROFESSION, STRENGTHEN THE REGULATIONS GOVERNING THE PRACTICE OF TEACHING IN THE PHILIPPINES AND PRESCRIBING A LICENSURE EXAMINATION FOR TEACHERS, REVISING FOR THE PURPOSE PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 1006, AS AMENDED AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Philippine Teachers Professionaliza tion  Act of 1991" Provides for   the (1)   creation of   a PROFESSIONAL BOARD   FOR TEACHERS; (2)   its composition, powers and functions; term of office and compensation; (3) fees for examination; scope of examination; (4) qualification requirements of applicants; and (5) other related matters. * * *
rows.status: Substituted by HB13059

rows.abstract: Increases  the insurance liability for DEATH OR BODILY INJURIES  of third  parties and/or passengers  re use of motor vehicles; sets  a UNIFORM minimum insurance coverage PER passenger or third  party REGARDLESS  OF THE AUTHORIZED CAPACITY of the vehicle involved. * * *
